# promise

In [EhOsContract.Process](process-dsl.md), section `process`.

```elixir
promise name
```

After one event of a run, another eventually follows.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="process-promise-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The promise's name. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="process-promise-from"></a>`from` | `atom` | yes |  | The event that opens the promise. |
| <a id="process-promise-eventually"></a>`eventually` | `atom` | yes |  | The event that keeps it. |
| <a id="process-promise-within"></a>`within` | `any` |  |  | `{n, unit}`, in a fixed unit. |
| <a id="process-promise-or_else"></a>`or_else` | `atom` |  |  | An event that keeps it the other way. |
| <a id="process-promise-unverified"></a>`unverified` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Not confirmed by the process owner. |
| <a id="process-promise-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the promise comes from. |
